verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs cover user migration (import/export) and log streaming/export, but no evidence pack item describes user-data deletion (e.g., GDPR erasure) or configurable data-retention policies for tenant/user data, which is a fair expectation for an identity platform handling PII and AI-agent context. missing for 10: explicit data-retention configuration, right-to-erasure/delete-user API documentation, retention period controls for logs/PII.
